reason: Gap is real: WAGR-22 (Training, Enablement & Admin Handoff) is live Open, unassigned, no description, 0 comments, 0 child issues, and JQL finds no other training ticket. But the claim overstates firmness: the super-user/train-the-trainer model was reaffirmed in direction on 2026-07-08, yet the training/go-live plan was left to be drafted and reviewed later (L0919). Jumpr only offered to run end-user sessions and office hours. Recorded videos were deferred on 2026-08-06 (L1583), and go-live has no date (WAGR-23 comment, 2026-08-10).
q1: Found. The Onsite doc (1NwBfx21...) at line 771 and line 776 (00:49:40 and 00:49:58) has both quote segments, verbatim after whitespace normalization. The Kickoff doc (1A44vvYC...) at line 536 and line 539 (00:40:25) has both segments verbatim. The second Kickoff segment is an excerpt from the middle of Kobi's turn ('...Did it did it ah sorry the data migration needs to be done...'), so no words were changed.
q2: Partly supported. Kickoff, lines 525-541: Kobi proposed train-the-trainer with recorded sessions and also offered to train end users (ledger L0350 marks this 'Not confirmed'). He then said training and go-live come near the end of Phase 1, so the timing claim holds. Onsite, lines 765-805: the transcript gives every line to Kobi Kunasekaran (diarization failure). The 'Who's going to be doing the training for us? ... I liked that approach' lines read like a WagerTech speaker, not Kobi, so the speaker attribution in the claim is unreliable. The approach was reaffirmed, but the passage ends with Jumpr offering help with 'training sessions, office hours, if you want to consider us helping' and 'We'll come up with a plan and then like let's rub it together next week' (L0919). So the model is an agreed direction, but scope, who delivers the sessions, and the schedule were not decided. 'The client meetings decided a super-user model' is too strong.
q3: No reversal found. Later items refine the scope: L1580-L1582 (08-06) Taryn drafts a rep training doc; L1583 (08-06) training videos are deferred until the build is near complete; L1707/L1709 (08-11) a living user-facing training manual and an admin user manual are started, with no deliverable date; L2183 (08-31) a written handover doc replaces video for page documentation; L2582 (09-15) field purpose is covered in record-page documentation and training; L2918 (09-23) users pin their list during onboarding; L3042 (09-24) Loom walkthroughs on Slack for done features. None of these drops the super-user model. They add documentation work that is also untracked in Jira, so the gap is wider, not closed. The WAGR-23 comment (2026-08-10) says the Aug 15 go-live is off with no new date, which lowers near-term urgency.
q4: Not covered. WAGR-22 (live): Epic, Open, unassigned, no description, 0 comments, due 2026-08-14 (past), Phase 1, MoSCoW Should Have. 'parent = WAGR-22' returns 0 issues; cf[10227]='Training & Handoff' returns only WAGR-22. JQL 'text ~ training OR train' returns only WAGR-22. JQL for manual/super user/enablement/onboarding/office hours returns about 95 issues, which are build stories that match 'manual' (manual processes) and do not cover training. WAGR-186 (BA user setup runbook, Done) covers part of the admin handoff only. WAGR-23 (Phase 1 Go-Live milestone, Open, 2 comments) has no training gate.
corrections: Onsite 2026-07-08 speaker: the transcript gives all lines to Kobi Kunasekaran (diarization failure). The 'I liked that approach ... super users' line is probably a WagerTech speaker. Do not cite it as Kobi's statement.

Rephrase 'client meetings decided' to 'agreed direction (train-the-trainer / super users, recorded), with the training plan still to be drafted (L0919)'. Add L0350 (Kickoff proposal) and L0919 (plan pending) as context.
Add the untracked training-documentation work (L1707 user manual, L1709 admin manual, L1580-L1582) to the suggested child tickets under WAGR-22.
WAGR-22 due date 2026-08-14 has passed and the go-live date is unset (WAGR-23 comment, 2026-08-10).
